text.description_html:
Acorn RSCBR, Old World Rough Black Iron Heart Rim Latch Set

The Rough Black Iron Old World Heart Rim Latch Set will add historic charm to any door. This Rim Latch Set is most commonly used on gates or doors that do not need to be locked with a key. The Old World Rough Black Iron Heart Rim Latch Set comes with a heart tip handle that is good both exterior and the interior use and an easy flip down locking device for privacy. Reversible for right or left handing and comes with reverse bevel so it will work on doors that open in or out. it will fit 7/8 inch to 1-3/4 inch door thicknesses.

Rough Black Iron: A rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the naturally weathered iron.

Also available Smooth Black Iron Heart Rim Latch Set

Specifications: of the Old World Heart Rim Latch Set:

  • Passage door handle for hall side of door
  • Reverse bevel / closet door handle for room side or exterior of storm door
  • Includes all necessary hardware.
  • Field reservable.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Features of the Rim Latch Set:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Handle Height: 8-3/4"
  • Handle Width: 2-1/4"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Door Thickness: 7/8" to 1 3/4"

Sold as a set.
